author: Captain_Craft755
body:
Hi, I have been on the Avicus Network for roughly half a year now and since the begging Ive had a goal to become a Jr. Mod. I was a jerk at the beginning but I Have really tried to clean up my act.
I have witnessed a lot of weird situations in my time on Avicus. So I have to ask When is the staff application and how do you qualify for a spot, Because i really want to achieve that goal
